The reporter labelled it MEDIUM (race-scoped sentence plus the YuzuAuditPersistFailures alert); the derived band governs per SKILL.md and E6 is not established. Same root as the false 'fire-and-forget' comment (g01-gov-13). The sentence came from the owner's ruling text (record the race and its reasoning); the fix keeps the race content and adds the limit.
classification_rationale: doc claim contradicts code behaviour next to an audit control
